tool.name: code_search_for_domain
tool.description:
Search public code hosts (GitHub Code Search, GitLab) for references to the org's apex domain.
A staple of real-world external recon. GitHub's index covers tens of millions of public repos and pulls up dev/staging URLs that DNS enumeration alone will never see, plus accidentally-committed secrets adjacent to those URLs. Use this tool during the recon phase for any `domain` target.
Behaviour: - For each hit, an info-severity finding (CWE-200, info_disclosure) is emitted with the repo + file + snippet as evidence. - When a snippet contains secret-indicator tokens (api_key / secret / password / bearer / AWS-style key prefixes / GitHub PAT prefixes / Slack tokens / etc.) near the domain reference, severity escalates to **high** with category=`secret_leak` and CWE-798. The verification_status is `needs_review` for these — the agent should fetch the file and confirm. - Subdomains extracted from snippets are returned in `extracted_subdomains` for handoff to the next phase (subdomain enum, fingerprint).
Provider keys: - `STRIX_GITHUB_TOKEN` — required for GitHub. A free GitHub PAT (no scopes needed for public code search) is sufficient. Without it, GitHub is silently dropped from the default provider set. - `STRIX_GITLAB_TOKEN` — optional for GitLab; raises the unauthenticated rate limit.
Categories: `info_disclosure`, `secret_leak`. CWEs: `CWE-200`, `CWE-798`.

parameter.name: domain
parameter.description: Apex or subdomain to search for. The exact string is queried (quoted).

parameter.name: providers
parameter.description: Comma-separated subset of {github, gitlab}. Default: "all" (key-gated providers fall back gracefully).

parameter.name: max_results
parameter.description: Maximum hits per provider. Default 30, capped at 100 by the API.

returns.description: {success, domain, providers_queried, per_provider: [{provider, success, total_count?, hits, error?}], extracted_subdomains, hit_count, secret_leak_count}.
